Name: Lowlands
Details: The Lowlands biome features rolling hills and gentle slopes, as well as thick woodlands that provide cover. Areas of marshland offer increased stability. Weather Conditions: • Gravity: +/-15% efficacy of Jump Jets and DFA damage • Dawn/Dusk: +1 To Hit with all weapons, negative removed if target is above 75 heat • Night: +2 To Hit with all weapons, -1 to hit per 60 heat of the target, 10% movement speed reduction • Foggy: 10% movement speed reduction • Moderate Gale: +1 To Hit with Missile based weapons • Strong Gale: +2 To Hit with Missile based weapons, +1 To Hit with Ballistic based weapons • Moderate Rain: +1 To Hit with all weapons
